product.scientific_scope: Characterizes sea-surface temperature, temperature anomalies, spatial configuration, and thermal-event evolution. It is not an official Coastal El Niño magnitude classification.

analysis.data_latency_reason: generated date minus latest selected observation date

climatology.calendar_mapping: stable month-day mapping on canonical leap year 2000
climatology.leap_day_method: February 29 is bin 60; non-leap years have no direct bin-60 sample but may contribute through the circular sampling window

representativeness.class_label_es: Calentamiento fuerte con alta variabilidad espacial
representativeness.class_label_en: Strong warming with high spatial variability

quality_flags.message_es: Al menos un track activo toca el límite del dominio.
quality_flags.message_en: At least one active track touches the domain boundary.

limitations.statement_es: No constituye una clasificación oficial de la magnitud de El Niño Costero.
limitations.statement_en: It is not an official Coastal El Niño magnitude classification.

limitations.statement_es: Los resultados dependen de la climatología, los umbrales y la conectividad.
limitations.statement_en: Results depend on climatology, thresholds, and connectivity.

limitations.statement_es: Los tracks representan rasgos térmicos enlazados, no parcelas individuales de agua.
limitations.statement_en: Tracks represent linked thermal features, not individual water parcels.

limitations.statement_es: Los rasgos que tocan los límites pueden extenderse fuera del dominio.
limitations.statement_en: Features touching domain boundaries may extend beyond the domain.

limitations.statement_es: Los datos faltantes o inválidos pueden reducir la cobertura.
limitations.statement_en: Missing or invalid data may reduce coverage.

limitations.statement_es: La climatología diaria representa las condiciones de referencia de 1991–2020.
limitations.statement_en: The daily climatology represents 1991–2020 reference conditions.

limitations.statement_es: Las clases de representatividad son nominales, no ordinales.
limitations.statement_en: Representativeness classes are nominal, not ordinal.

prohibited_claims: official Coastal El Niño magnitude classification
causal attribution not supported by inputs
forecasts not present in the context
biological or fisheries impacts not present in the context
claims that tracks are individual water masses or individual water parcels
generation_constraints.numerical_fact_policy: Every numerical value included in the generated brief must correspond to a valid fact_id from fact_registry.
generation_constraints.uncertainty_policy: Report quality flags and unavailable facts explicitly; do not convert evidence scores into probabilities.
generation_constraints.official_classification_policy: Do not provide an official Coastal El Niño magnitude classification.
generation_constraints.citation_policy: Cite the source_id and fact_id carried by the context; do not invent external citations.
generation_constraints.missing_data_policy: Unavailable facts must not be inferred.
